SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.pickup_location, o.delivery_location, o.proposed_price, o.agreed_price, o.status, o.expected_delivery_time, o.create_time, o.requester_id, u.nick_name AS requester_nick_name, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar, o.picker_id FROM pickup_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.requester_id = u.id
o.status = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.pickup_location, o.delivery_location, o.proposed_price, o.agreed_price, o.status, o.expected_delivery_time, o.create_time, o.requester_id, ur.nick_name AS requester_nick_name, ur.avatar_url AS requester_avatar, o.picker_id, up.nick_name AS picker_nick_name, up.avatar_url AS picker_avatar FROM pickup_order o LEFT JOIN user ur ON o.requester_id = ur.id LEFT JOIN user up ON o.picker_id = up.id
o.is_deleted = 0
AND o.status = #{status}
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ur.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR up.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.requester_id, o.picker_id, o.pickup_code, o.pickup_location, o.pickup_detail, o.delivery_location, o.proposed_price, o.agreed_price, o.price_proposer_id, o.picker_price_confirmed, o.price_deadline, o.expected_delivery_time, o.delivery_deadline, o.evidence_images, o.requester_confirmed, o.picker_confirmed, o.status, o.cancel_reason, o.cancel_by, o.confirm_deadline, o.complete_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, ur.nick_name AS requester_nick_name, ur.avatar_url AS requester_avatar, ur.phone AS requester_phone, up.nick_name AS picker_nick_name, up.avatar_url AS picker_avatar, up.phone AS picker_phone, up.pickup_score AS picker_score FROM pickup_order o LEFT JOIN user ur ON o.requester_id = ur.id LEFT JOIN user up ON o.picker_id = up.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.pickup_location, o.pickup_detail, o.delivery_location, o.proposed_price, o.expected_delivery_time, o.create_time, c.name AS campus_name, o.requester_id, u.nick_name AS requester_nick_name, u.avatar_url AS requester_avatar FROM pickup_order o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.requester_id = u.id LEFT JOIN campus c ON o.campus_id = c.id
o.status = 0 AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.expected_delivery_time > NOW()
AND o.campus_id = #{campusId}
AND (o.pickup_location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR o.delivery_location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND o.proposed_price >= #{minPrice}
AND o.proposed_price <= #{maxPrice}
AND o.expected_delivery_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
AND o.expected_delivery_time <= CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY o.proposed_price DESC, o.expected_delivery_time ASC
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
ORDER BY o.expected_delivery_time ASC, o.proposed_price DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pickup_order SET evidence_images = #{evidenceImages} WHERE id = #{id}
